prompt: Ultra-realistic Japanese high school yearbook portrait of a beautiful teenage girl, centered in a formal graduation photo layout. She has long, silky jet-black hair styled in a loose side braid draped over one shoulder, soft wispy curtain bangs, luminous porcelain-fair skin, subtle rosy cheeks, naturally full pink lips, and large expressive dark brown eyes with a calm, slightly melancholic gaze looking directly into the camera. Her expression is neutral, quiet, and elegant with a gentle, introspective mood. She is wearing a traditional Japanese high school uniform consisting of a tailored black blazer, crisp white dress shirt, and a deep burgundy satin ribbon bow. The portrait is framed from the chest upward against a smooth light blue-gray studio backdrop with soft, even school-photography lighting, minimal shadows, and true-to-life colors. The portrait is printed on a clean white yearbook page with thin white borders separating neighboring student portraits. Japanese kanji characters are printed beneath the portrait as the student's name, creating an authentic Japanese graduation album aesthetic. Adjacent student portraits are partially visible on both sides, reinforcing the official class yearbook layout. Style: ultra-realistic, Japanese school graduation album photography, minimalist composition, authentic yearbook design, soft natural skin tones, high detail, DSLR quality, shallow depth of field, sharp facial focus, subtle cinematic realism, 8K resolution.

promptZh: 超写实的日本高中毕业纪念册肖像，主角为 一位美丽的少女，居中呈现于正式的毕业照排版中。她拥有 乌黑柔顺的长发，编成松散的侧边麻花辫垂在肩头，配有轻盈的八字刘海，肤色如瓷般透亮，双颊透着淡淡红晕，嘴唇自然饱满，深棕色的双眸大而有神，目光平静且略带忧郁地直视镜头。她的表情中性、恬静而优雅，流露出一种温柔且内省的氛围。她穿着 传统的日本高中校服，包括剪裁合体的黑色西装外套、挺括的白色衬衫以及深酒红色的缎面领结。肖像采用胸部以上的取景，背景为平滑的浅蓝灰色摄影棚幕布，光线柔和均匀，呈现出校园摄影的质感，阴影极少，色彩真实自然。肖像印在干净的白色纪念册页面上，边缘有细窄的留白，与其他学生的肖像隔开。肖像下方印有作为学生姓名的日文汉字，营造出地道的日本毕业相册美感。两侧隐约可见其他学生的肖像，强化了正式班级纪念册的排版效果。风格：超写实、日本学校毕业相册摄影、极简构图、地道纪念册设计、柔和自然的肤色、高细节、单反相机画质、浅景深、面部焦点清晰、细腻的电影感写实、8K 分辨率。
